## Write-risk import tool, proposal only
Parses pasted or attached CSV/TSV text into prospect rows, validates every row, and stores the exact parsed rows as a pending action. Nothing is imported until the user replies with the exact confirmation phrase, which 40 - CONFIRM - Task Write checks before 72 executes the import.

Column headers are matched loosely (Company, Region, Tier, Source, Website, Contact Name, Contact Email, LinkedIn URL, PDF Sent, Sent Date, Opened, Follow-up Sent, Status, Notes). Company is required; at most 200 rows.
